title: 【青丝怨06】无人该死
slug: 回溯凶案现场全警局坐等我破案
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

‘吱呀’一声，沉重的铁包木门被人从外面

椅子上那戴着手铐、被五花小绑的男人下意识睁开眼，一双颓然麻木的眼睛朝着门口的方向望去。

定定地盯着孟长离看了好一瞬，才看似满不在乎地收回了视线。

透过他头顶那昏黄的灯光，孟长离没有错过对方在看到她的头发时，眼底那一闪而过的痴迷和扭曲的恨意。

孟长离坐下后，状似随意地将辫子拨到身前。

这才看向对面的男人，开口道：“王兵，我尝试着站在你的角度去思考，发现后面三名死者确实都有该死的缘由。毕竟不论是卷发、短发还是妇人髻，在你看来都属于‘不正经’的那一类。”

王兵低垂着头不去看她，攥紧双拳不发一语。

孟长离也不在意，自顾自地往下说：“但我实在是理解不了，为什么陈二丫也要死？机床厂给你分配的房子，就在陈二丫家楼下。这抬头不见低头见的，你应该对她的处境很了解才对啊。”

“重男轻女的父母每天对她非打即骂，小小年纪就辍学在家干尽所有脏活累活，过着仆人一样的生活。她都过得那么惨了，况且她扎的也是麻花辫啊，虽然是双股辫，但应该也罪不至死吧？”

王兵刻意避开和孟长离对视，转头看向郭保国，粗声粗气道：

“我都说了我没杀人！到底什么时候才能把我放了，我今天还要回厂子里头上班呢，没功夫听你们讲故事！”

郭保国猛地一拍桌，厉声喝道：“我们敢抓你就说明手里有证据！专家问你话你就老实回答，别想耍滑头！”

“答不了，我没文化，你们读书人说的话我听不懂！”王兵干脆闭上眼睛靠在了椅背上，双腿交叉互扣起脚踝，一副拒绝交流的模样。

“其实自从我昨天从机床厂回来以后，心里就有了一个猜想。陈二丫之所以会死，是因为她的父母对吗？”

孟长离起身走到他身边，边来回踱步边轻声说：“3月15日是你女儿的头七，那天你结束丧假回到厂子里头上班。而王秀芬是个大嗓门，平时最爱搬弄是非，应该是说了什么不中听的话让你听见了吧？郭队，您也没少跟王秀芬打交道，能猜到她会说些什么吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

With a 'squeak' sound, the heavy iron-clad wooden door was opened by someone from the outside.

The handcuffed and tied man on the chair subconsciously opened his eyes, looking towards the door with a pair of slumped and numb eyes.

He stared at Meng Changli for a long moment, and then looked away seemingly nonchalantly.

Through the dim light above his head, Meng Changli did not miss the flash of obsession and twisted hatred in the other person's eyes when he saw her hair.

After Meng Changli sat down, he moved his braids in front of him as if casually.

Then he looked at the man opposite and said, "Wang Bing, I tried to think from your point of view and found that the three deceased people behind did have their own reasons for death. After all, whether they have curly hair, short hair or a bun, they all fall into the category of 'improper' in your opinion."

Wang Bing lowered his head and did not look at her, clenched his fists and said nothing.

Meng Changli didn't care and continued on to himself: "But I really can't understand why Chen Erya has to die too? The house assigned to you by the machine tool factory is just downstairs from Chen Erya's house. You can't see her when you look up, so you should know her situation very well."

"Her parents who favored boys over girls beat and scolded her every day. She dropped out of school at a young age and did all the dirty work at home, living like a servant. She has lived such a miserable life, and besides, she also wears braids. Although it is a double braid, it shouldn't be a crime worthy of death, right?"

Wang Bing deliberately avoided looking at Meng Changli, turned to look at Guo Baoguo, and said in a rough voice:

"I told you I didn't kill anyone! When will I be released? I have to go back to work in the factory today, so I don't have time to listen to your stories!"

Guo Baoguo slammed the table and shouted: "If we dare to arrest you, it means we have evidence! If the experts ask you, answer them honestly. Don't try to be cunning!"

"I can't answer that. I'm uneducated. I can't understand what you scholars are saying!" Wang Bing simply closed his eyes and leaned on the back of his chair, crossing his legs and clasping his ankles, as if refusing to communicate.

"Actually, since I came back from the machine tool factory yesterday, I have had a guess in my mind. The reason why Chen Erya died was because of her parents, right?"

Meng Changli stood up and walked to him, pacing back and forth while whispering: "March 15th is your daughter's first birthday. That day you returned to the factory to work after your bereavement leave. Wang Xiufen is a loud voice, and she likes to make trouble. I guess she said something unpleasant for you to hear, right? Captain Guo, you have dealt with Wang Xiufen a lot, can you guess what she will say?"
